faults.fault: Taller resize (image 4) dumped the extra height into a stretched blank panel below the cabinet instead of into the cabinet's own members -- a huge smeared dark slab with a hard edge across the base. Reads as a stretched texture, not a taller jukebox. Blocking.

Bubble tubes stay 'fixed', so when the prop is made taller the glowing tube columns do NOT run longer between the arched top and base -- the vertical detail that should absorb the height simply stops and blank panel carries on below. Blocking.

Widened prop (image 3) shows thin red streak/seam lines running horizontally across the added wood flanks where the texture repeats cut instead of reflecting, plus dark vertical voids between the added flank panels and the original body where background shows through. Blocking.
